description: Comment thread component with inline rich text editing via TmRichEditorSimple. Supports adding, editing, and deleting comments with author avatars, relative timestamps, and edit indicators. Communicates changes via EventCallbacks.

parameters.name: OnDraftChanged
parameters.description: Fires when the comment draft state changes (editor opened/closed, edited comment changed) — value-equality deduped, so it does NOT fire on every keystroke. Consumers use TmCommentDraftState to build a dirty-guard before discarding an in-progress comment; the record carries flags only, never the draft text.

examples.title: Discarding an unsaved comment draft via @ref
examples.code:
<TmActivityComments @ref="_comments"
                     Comments="@comments"
                     OnCommentAdded="HandleAdd"
                     OnCommentDeleted="HandleDelete"
                     OnCommentEdited="HandleEdit" />

@code {
    private TmActivityComments? _comments;

    private async Task DiscardUnsavedDraftAsync()
    {
        // HasUnsavedDraft mirrors the OnDraftChanged HasUnsavedContent flag; read it on the
        // component's dispatcher (an event handler or InvokeAsync) from background threads.
        if (_comments is not null && _comments.HasUnsavedDraft && await Confirm())
        {
            await _comments.DiscardDraftAsync();
        }
    }
}
